compared: For every test image (matched by image_id) the app's predicted class (argmax of its prior-corrected probabilities, alpha 0.3) was compared with y_pred_corrected in the npz, and the app's corrected probabilities with probs_corrected. The npz already contains corrected values; re-applying the app's prior correction to probs_raw was used only to check that the file is internally consistent.
verdict_text: 96.92% identical class (62 of 2014 differ); largest probability difference 0.8271
